date.as_written: samvat 538 māghakṛṣṇaaṣṭaṃmyāyāṃ viśāṣapraarādhanakṣatre || dhruvayoge || śanaiścaravāsare || saṃpūrṇṇadine

purpose: svayaṃ pāṭhārthahetunā: for Madanabhadra's own reading/study (the book belongs to Madanabhadra, pustaka madanabhadrasya)
notes: The cataloguer's "Donor: Madanabhadra" is better read as owner/commissioner: the manuscript is his (madanabhadrasya) and was written for his own study (svayaṃ pāṭhārthahetunā); no gift to another party is mentioned. Cāvihāra (Cā-bāhā) could be in Kathmandu or Patan, so normalization left empty. Nakṣatra name is corrupt (viśāṣapraarādha), presumably viśākhā. The jyotirmalla reign (c. 1408–1428) fits NS 538 = c. Jan/Feb 1418 CE. Text title "nirghaṇṭhaśāstra/nāmasaṃgraha" (Nighaṇṭu) is not a person; no author named.
